> Supporting record: claims apply to the revisions and environments named below; this page does not qualify a later candidate.

The final source suite passed **205 cases and 5,069 expectations**, with no
failures, errors, warnings or skips. It includes both independently identified
fit families, nested-cache migration, actual low-MOI NT CRT execution, and the
public incompatible-context cache transplant regression.

All seven reference workflows match exactly at tolerance zero across 231
comparisons: completed calibration/power/discovery tables, available preparation
values, compact response-fit values, warnings and R RNG state. The archived
flat-slot numerical reference uses matched budgets: its accidental calibration
B3 overwrite is reset to the prepared discovery/power budget before those runs.
This is not a claim of parity with that old overwrite behavior. The original
reference has no perturbation cache; that new payload is qualified separately.

`test-fit-cache-families.R` checks cold/warm real complement and low-MOI NT runs,
actual logistic fit counts, exact reconstructed probabilities, common context
stored once, three per-entry input hashes without copied cell vectors, both
public transplant miss paths, independent invalidation, calibration bypass,
fresh sampling and worker-failure atomicity. `test-perturbation-model.R` checks
original inverse-link arithmetic, rank-deficient/nonfinite/inexact fallback,
one actual fit, warning behavior and native sampling equivalence. Warm reuse
intentionally emits no repeated regression warning; cold numerical parity and
explicit warning tests delimit that behavior.

`source-suite-summary.json` contains machine-readable totals; the log and RDS
preserve the full suite. `parity-summary.json`, `parity-checks.rds`,
`parity-current.rds` and `parity.log` preserve comparison outcomes.
`tested-source-sha256.json` binds R/native/test source files; `provenance.json`
binds evidence and the unchanged schema3 reference artifact. Source scripts
run from the repository root with the compiled local library and developer
dependencies. The historical schema3 and RunPlan evidence is preserved separately.

This is local numerical and lifecycle qualification. It does not establish
large-screen speed/memory gains, cross-platform arithmetic portability or
Nextflow compatibility. Native sampling and statistical kernels are unchanged.
